description: Prerequisites: T003-mail-selection, T005-todoist-api, and T006-reconciliation. Compose the fixed Inbox task and coordinate Mail, Keychain, Todoist, reconciliation, and typed outcome ports without live dependencies in tests.
acceptance: One selected mail produces a Reply to title, sender/date/deep-link description, mail label, no project override, and no inferred scheduling fields.
Confirmed, existing, safe failure, and reconciliation-needed outcomes are distinct and no failure path mutates Mail or duplicates Todoist work.
